profileChannelRule: A profile issue whose code is in DECLARATION_QUALITY_CODES is reported in the DECLARATION_QUALITY channel and does not fail the item. EVERY OTHER code stays a HARD failure, including codes not seen in the Canary: marks and mark-scheme structure, response format, command terms, calculator rules on stated or keyed numbers, value ranges and parameter constraints (they are about the numbers of the item).

originalityRule.MATERIAL_DUPLICATE: FAILS the gate. (1) textual similarity at the existing reject threshold (0.8) with another item; or (2) the same construct with the WHOLE parameter set equal to another item's; or (3) for an item with a situation: a near-duplicate scenario (similarity >= 0.4) AND a shared defining parameter pair with the SAME other item.
originalityRule.MATHEMATICAL_TEMPLATE_SIMILARITY: A signal, not a failure: a defining parameter pair shared with another item of the construct, without the whole set and without a near-duplicate scenario.
originalityRule.STRUCTURAL_SIMILARITY: A signal, not a failure: textual similarity in the existing review band (0.5 to 0.8), or -- for an item with a situation -- a near-duplicate scenario without a shared parameter pair.
originalityRule.abstractItems: Scenario similarity is NOT APPLIED to an item whose context is ABSTRACT: it has no scenario, and its framing sentence is its family's.

readers.LINE_THROUGH_TWO_POINTS: two points written as (x, y) in the stem; asked: the value of y at a stated x, the slope, an intercept, or the equation
readers.QUADRATIC_EQUATION_RATIONAL_ROOTS_BY_FAC: the quadratic equation written in the stem (either side, or factorised); asked: greater root, lesser root, sum, product
readers.QUADRATIC_MODEL_VERTEX_OPTIMUM: two linear factors, written as expressions in x or as "starts at ... and increases / decreases by ..."; asked: the maximising x, or the maximum value
readers.COMPARISON_OF_TWO_CLASSICAL_PROBABILITIE: four counts in the stem, read as two (favourable, total) pairs in order; asked: which option is higher or lower (verdict). A keyed NUMBER is checked for consistency only
readers.UNIT_RATE_COMPARISON_OF_TWO_OPTIONS: four amounts in the stem, read as two pairs in order; which way the rate runs is NOT read, so a key is checked for consistency only
readers.CLASSICAL_PROBABILITY_SINGLE_DRAW: two counts in the stem; which event is asked about is NOT read, so a key is checked for consistency only
readers.DIRECT_PROPORTION_MISSING_VALUE: three numbers in the stem; which correspond is NOT read, so a key is checked against every pairing for consistency only
readers.LINEAR_MODEL_FIXED_START_CONSTANT_RATE: a table of a line in the stimulus, or a start and a rate in the stem; asked: the equation. A keyed NUMBER is checked for consistency only
readers.RELATIVE_CHANGE_OR_SHARE_FROM_TABULATED_: two rows of the stimulus table named in the question, in the order named; asked: the percentage change
readers.CLAIM_EVALUATION_AGAINST_A_DATA_DISPLAY: NO READER: whether a display supports a statement is not recomputed. Every key of this construct is UNVERIFIED

changeLog.change: A key is verified only by recomputation from learner-visible text. Agreement with the generator's declared parameters, target or arithmetic verifies nothing.
changeLog.evidence: c250-070: wrong key (120; the stem gives 16.875) classed MACHINE_VERIFIED by revision 4 from the declared parameters.

changeLog.change: A key is not failed because it disagrees with the quantity the generator DECLARED as target, or with the generator's declared arithmetic. The disagreement becomes a declaration flag.
changeLog.evidence: c250-004, 079, 090 (key is y at a stated x; revision 4 compared it with the intercept); c250-048 (key 13254 is right; the declared expression gives 4816.5).

changeLog.change: Sign, percent-unit and rounding differences are REPRESENTATION_DIFFERENCE with their subtype, not a failed key. Rounding to a whole number counts only when the text asks for rounding.
changeLog.evidence: c250-146 (0.5 against -0.5), c250-153 (2.5 percentage points against 0.025), c250-194 (0.321 against 0.3214...).

changeLog.change: New classes. STEM_CONSISTENT (the key is a quantity the stem determines, the asked quantity was not read) and UNVERIFIED are not verifications; where no reader exists the class is UNVERIFIED.
changeLog.evidence: Revision 4 verified 139 of 221 keys, all through declarations.

changeLog.change: Options that are equations are compared as equations: different lines are different options even when they share a number.
changeLog.evidence: c250-019: y = x - 4 and y = -x + 4 failed as "the same number"; the key is correct.

changeLog.change: Two options that are equivalent equations (reordered, scaled, fraction or decimal) are the same option.
changeLog.evidence: No Canary case; the counterpart of B1, with synthetic fixtures.

changeLog.change: Scenario similarity is not applied to ABSTRACT items.
changeLog.evidence: 66 items carried near-duplicate-scenario findings; framing sentences such as "In the coordinate plane, two points are A(..) and B(..)" score 1.0 against their siblings.

changeLog.change: Three notions. Only MATERIAL_DUPLICATE fails; a shared parameter pair alone, a near-duplicate scenario alone, and textual similarity in the review band are reported signals.
changeLog.evidence: Orchestrator instruction; 57 items failed revision 4 on originality alone. The QB-R2E pair 06 a2 / 07 (scenario AND shared pair) is still a material duplicate.
